attributes.name: Application group
attributes.description: Top level of the two-level application vocabulary; derived from application values.

attributes.name: Autonomy
attributes.description: Highest level of unsupervised operation supported out of the box. Programmed: runs a taught or coded sequence without sensing its surroundings (most industrial arms).
attributes.question: What is the highest level of unsupervised operation out of the box?

attributes.name: Collaborative
attributes.description: The maker states it meets the robot requirements for collaborative applications in ISO 10218-1:2025 (or the earlier ISO/TS 15066), usually through built-in power and force limiting. Under ISO 10218:2025 an application, not a robot, is confirmed as collaborative, after its own risk assessment.
attributes.question: Does the maker state it meets the ISO 10218-1:2025 (or ISO/TS 15066) requirements for collaborative applications?

bases.description: Complete product ready to operate, with battery, without payload or accessories. Arm = manipulator only, without controller or cabinet. Never package or shipping weight.
Stated without battery.
Arm stated including its controller (only when no arm-only figure exists).

attributes.name: Payload
attributes.description: Rated payload. Arm: at the wrist. Mobile robot: on the deck. End-effector: held object.
attributes.question: What is the rated payload?

bases.description: Rated payload as the spec sheet states it. Arm = at the flange/wrist. Mobile manipulator = at the arm's flange. Mobile, legged or humanoid robot = carried while moving. Humanoid = with both arms together. End-effector = held object.
A higher "maximum" figure at reduced reach, speed or posture, when no rated figure exists.
Static or standing load (legged or mobile robot not moving).
One arm of a humanoid or dual-arm robot.
Towed load (AMR / tugger).
Magnetic or vacuum grip with the load acting parallel to the gripping face (shear), when only that figure is given. The default for these grippers is a straight pull off a flat part.

attributes.name: Battery runtime
attributes.description: Manufacturer-rated runtime on one charge.
attributes.question: What is the manufacturer-rated battery runtime?

bases.description: The maker's headline runtime in normal operation, without payload ("up to" figures included). A range "1-2 h" → record the upper end.
Runtime with payload or under a stated working load, when no headline figure exists.
Standby / idle time.

attributes.name: Drive configuration
attributes.description: How a ground base steers and propels itself, as the maker states it. Differential: two independently driven wheels, turning by speed difference. Skid-steer: four or more fixed wheels driven as left and right sides, turning by skidding. Omnidirectional: mecanum, omni or swerve wheels. Ackermann: car-like steered wheels. Tracked: continuous tracks. Self-balancing: two wheels on one axle kept upright by active balance.
attributes.question: What drive configuration does the spec sheet state?
